title: Rival Watch
summary: Each week, read your top rivals' pricing, key pages, page list, Meta ads, news and Google rankings, compare them with last week's snapshot, and report only the changes that matter, with before and after quotes and links.
outcome: What your top 3 rivals changed this week (prices, plans, pages, ads, rankings), with proof.
boundary: Public sources only: up to 3 rivals, 10 money keywords and one country, compared week to week. Not a real-time alert, a full-site crawl or every ad network; cosmetic changes are hidden; no logins, contact with rivals, republishing of their content or changes to your site.

catalog_tools.purpose: Read each rival's pricing, home and changelog pages and its sitemap (the only source of a page list; a sitemap that is cut off, missing or not XML means no page list that week).
Confirm a price change with a second read, or recover a page the first read missed.
Find each rival's news from the last week and check live Google positions (top 10) for the money keywords.
Second Google search route when a ranking search fails.
List each rival's newest 30 active Meta ads to spot new offers and messages.
Count each rival's ranking keywords gained, improved, dropped and lost, with estimated traffic.

inputs: Up to 3 rivals; the agent suggests some if you don't have them
Up to 10 money keywords: the searches that bring you buyers
outputs: A one-screen weekly summary: up to 5 material changes, the biggest ranking move and the rivals that stayed quiet
Before and after quotes, links and capture dates for every change
Live Google positions (top 10) for your money keywords, for you and each rival
A saved snapshot so next week compares like with like
Receipts, sources and limits in a Details section, and a hand-off to Next SEO Moves for SEO deep-dives

cost.model: Per-call page reads and Google searches, plus one Meta ads lookup and one domain overview per rival, each week.
cost.notes: Re-inspect each week. At 14 October 2026 prices a typical week costs about $0.11 for 3 rivals and 10 keywords and about $0.07 for 2 rivals and 5 keywords. The maximum for 3 rivals and 10 keywords, including price confirmations and fallbacks, is $0.151900 in the first week (one extra home-links read per rival) and $0.144400 after that.

approvals: Approve the rivals, money keywords, country and weekly maximum before the first paid call
A standing weekly approval covers only the same inputs and maximum; any change needs a new yes
Pause for a server confirmation request
No logins, contact with rivals, publishing or website changes
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with discover, inspect, run and wallet
A local folder for the weekly snapshot file
